owners.command:
mkdir -p playwright-report; npx playwright test \
  tests/admin-user-operations.spec.ts \
  tests/impersonation.spec.ts \
  tests/admin-audit.spec.ts \
  tests/admin-theme.spec.ts \
  tests/admin-coherence-sweep.spec.ts \
  tests/admin-modal-interaction.spec.ts \
  tests/admin-flow-platform-admin.spec.ts \
  tests/admin-flow-support-investigator.spec.ts \
  tests/admin-flow-org-admin.spec.ts \
  --project=chromium \
  --retries=0 --list --reporter=json > playwright-report/admin-behavior.selection.json

mkdir -p playwright-report; npx playwright test \
  tests/admin-checkpoints.spec.ts \
  --project=admin-checkpoints-chromium \
  --project=admin-checkpoints-mobile \
  --project=admin-checkpoints-dark \
  --retries=0 --list --reporter=json > playwright-report/admin-checkpoints.selection.json

mkdir -p playwright-report; npx playwright test \
  tests/admin-design.spec.ts \
  --project=admin-design-chromium \
  --project=admin-design-mobile \
  --project=admin-design-dark \
  --grep-invert '@snapshot' \
  --retries=0 --list --reporter=json > playwright-report/design-gallery-pr-behavior.selection.json

mkdir -p playwright-report; npx playwright test \
  tests/golden-path.spec.ts \
  tests/ga-uat-shift-left.spec.ts \
  tests/passkeys-hooks.spec.ts \
  tests/organizations.spec.ts \
  tests/passkey-login.spec.ts \
  tests/passkey-options.spec.ts \
  --retries=0 --list --reporter=json > playwright-report/non-admin-smoke.selection.json

mkdir -p playwright-report; npx playwright test \
  tests/demo-showcase.spec.ts \
  --project=demo-showcase-chromium \
  --retries=0 --list --reporter=json > playwright-report/demo-showcase.selection.json
